kind: discrete ornament, positioned by Flutter - NOT a nine-patch
note: A ribbon is a THREE-patch - fixed swallowtail ends with a tiling middle - and the painter only does nine-patches. Measured band 6/0/0/0: the left and right "bands" are the notches, which are transparent at mid-height, so it cannot carry one uniform inset. It ships at its authored 96x32 and holds a short label (a level, a rarity, a boss mark, a cost). A label wider than that needs a three-patch painter, which is a separate change.
